meta.title: RS Studio — Scalable, performant software
meta.description: Software studio building scalable, performant products. Embedded teams or end-to-end projects from architecture to release.

hero.title: Software that strengthens local businesses and communities
hero.intro: RS Studio builds websites, digital products, automation systems, and custom software that help small businesses grow, operate more efficiently, and reach more customers.
hero.introMission:
We believe **great technology** should not be reserved for large companies.

Our mission is to build practical **digital solutions** that strengthen local economies, support community-driven projects, and give independent businesses access to **the same quality of tools** used by larger organizations.
hero.closing: When local businesses grow, everyone grows.
hero.screenAlt: A client site built by the studio, shown on a desktop screen
hero.phoneAlt: A client site built by the studio, shown on a phone

blog.title: Blog
blog.head: Notes
blog.description: Notes on architecture, product decisions, and what we learn shipping projects end to end.

services.title: Digital solutions to grow your business
services.intro: We build digital solutions to increase sales, automate processes and strengthen your business's online presence.

items.title: Landing pages
items.body: Websites that clearly present your services, build trust from first contact, and turn visitors into qualified leads.

items.title: WordPress online stores
items.body: We build WooCommerce ecommerce so you can sell products online, securely and easily managed.

items.title: Business management tool
items.body: A custom tool to manage customers, operations, inventory and appointments from one place.

items.title: Digital marketing
items.body: We manage Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns to generate leads and increase your return on investment.

cta.title: Not sure which solution your business needs?
cta.intro: We'll help you identify the best strategy for your goals and budget.
cta.whatsappMessage: Hi! I'd like to talk about which solution fits my business best.

servicePage.ctaIntro: Tell us about your project and we'll reply with a clear proposal and an honest estimate.

process.title: How we work
process.intro: Short cycles, visible progress, no surprises at the end. You get a working build every week.

steps.title: Scope
steps.body: A short paid discovery: goals, constraints, and what we are not building.

steps.title: Shape
steps.body: Architecture, data model and a milestone plan you can hold us to.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Weekly deploys to a staging URL. You see progress, not status reports.

steps.title: Hand over
steps.body: Documented code, CI, and a team that knows how to run it without us.

manifesto.title: Our vision
manifesto.intro: RS Studio intentionally partners with businesses and organizations that create local value.

items.title: Local economies
items.body: We prioritize projects that strengthen local businesses, entrepreneurship, and regional economic growth.

items.title: Sustainability
items.body: We actively seek opportunities to work with businesses that care about their environmental and social impact.

items.title: Community
items.body: We believe long-term relationships create stronger businesses and stronger communities.

items.title: Accessibility
items.body: We build practical, scalable technology solutions that are accessible to small businesses, not only large organizations.

contact.title: Have something to build?
contact.intro: Tell us the problem and the deadline. We'll reply within two business days with a plan and an honest estimate.
